description: Build exploratory Power BI visuals without leaving the report canvas Graph Builder is a Power BI custom visual for exploratory data analysis, EDA, data visualization, and interactive chart building. It turns Power BI into a hands-on data analyzer and explorer for analysts who want JMP- or Minitab-style flexibility inside their reports. Compare relationships, distributions, segments, trends, outliers, and multivariate patterns in one flexible visual. Add fields once, then build layered chart views with pages, facets, small multiples, axes, color, and size encodings directly inside Power BI. Why teams use Graph Builder Graph Builder helps report authors move beyond a single fixed chart type, chart visual, or static dashboard tile. It is designed for fast exploratory analysis, reusable report layouts, ad hoc analysis, visual analytics, and compact visual storytelling when business users need to inspect data from more than one angle. Build in Power BI Service: let users create and adjust charts directly in the Power BI Service so they can tailor views to how they want to explore the data even after publishing. Layer multiple chart types: combine a scatter plot, line chart, bar chart, heat map, histogram, box plot, trend line, regression line, and related chart views where the data relationship supports them.
